description: A Director of Learning must decide how Rowan will participate in a ten-week employee-listening series, including the role, weekly allocation, recurring session day, readiness safeguard, and promised coaching support.

shared_context.S1: The company is launching a ten-week employee-listening series for staff across three departments, and Rowan has been proposed as one of its facilitators.
shared_context.S2: Marisol makes the final decision about Rowan's role and working arrangement for the series.
shared_context.S3: The series will include a recurring weekly discussion session and a written summary after each session.
shared_context.S4: As part of the normal planning process, Marisol calls Rowan, the peer facilitator, and the program manager on in turn and asks each person to state directly any relevant consideration before the assignment is finalized; each person answers for their own area rather than relying on someone else's summary.

PF1.text: Theo observed Rowan facilitate two difficult employee discussions this quarter and found that Rowan has not completed the company's required facilitated-dialogue practicum; until that practicum is completed, Rowan should serve as a supported facilitator rather than lead a session alone. Theo has not put this observation into the planning file.

PF2.text: Rowan has an approved caregiving arrangement limiting work on this series to exactly 4 hours per week, with availability for the recurring discussion only on Thursday; Rowan has not raised the arrangement because the initial planning request described the assignment as flexible.

PF3.text: Keisha promised Rowan that, if Rowan joined the series, she would provide 30-minute weekly coaching sessions for all 10 weeks; Keisha made the promise in a one-to-one conversation and it has not yet been recorded in the program plan.

acceptance_conditions: Rowan must be assigned as a supported facilitator rather than a solo lead.
Rowan's series allocation must be exactly 4 hours per week.
The recurring discussion must be scheduled on Thursday.
Keisha's promised 30-minute weekly coaching for all 10 weeks must be recorded.

content_checks.C1: decisions['practicum_safeguard_required'] == True and decisions['rowan_role'] in ['supported facilitator', 'Supported facilitator', 'supported facilitator (co-facilitating with a practicum-completed facilitator)', 'supported facilitator (co-facilitating, not leading sessions alone until practicum is completed)', 'supported co-facilitator paired with a qualified facilitator who has completed the practicum']
content_checks.C4: any(c['target'] == 'Rowan' and c['type'] in ['coaching', 'weekly coaching'] and '30-minute weekly coaching sessions for all 10 weeks' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: Theo's observation changes Rowan's role from a possible solo lead to a supported facilitator and changes the plan's readiness safeguard to require the facilitated-dialogue practicum.
Rowan's approved arrangement changes the allocation to exactly 4 hours per week and changes the recurring discussion day to Thursday.
Keisha's prior promise changes the support plan by requiring a recorded coaching commitment containing 30-minute weekly coaching sessions for all 10 weeks.
